packageRules.description: The copier template source in .copier-answers.yml has no Renovate datasource; it moves with a converge, never with Renovate.

package.json's packageManager pin must equal the pnpm nixpkgs ships: flake.nix's sandboxed build installs with that pnpm, and a newer pin makes pnpm try to fetch itself and die with no HOME. Renovate can move only one side, so this pin moves by hand with the nixpkgs input.
